examples.arabic: بالليل سالها سؤال غريب كثير عن كلبهم
examples.english: At night he asked her a very strange question about their dog.
examples.transliteration: bel lel salaha suaal gharib ktiir aan kalbon

examples.arabic: كل ما تجاوب سؤال كان عنده عشرة غيره والام بلشت تحس بالتعب شوي
examples.english: Every time she answered a question he had ten others and the mother started to feel a bit tired.
examples.transliteration: Kull ma tjawib su'al kan ando ashara ghairo w el em ballashit tehes bil ta'ab shway.

examples.arabic: كل يوم الصبح بس يوعى رامي بيقعد يسأل امه مليون سؤال
examples.english: Every morning when Rami wakes up, he sits and asks his mother a million questions.
examples.transliteration: Kull yom es-subeh bas yoo'a Rami biq'od yis'al immo malyoon su'al

examples.arabic: بس سؤال أنا فضولي أعرف في مكان فينا نقعد فيه قريب من النهر
examples.english: But a question, I'm curious to know if there's a place where we can stay near the river?
examples.transliteration: Bas su'āl ana fudooli aʿref fi makān fīna noqʿod fīh qareeb min in-nahar?

examples.arabic: ضحكت الام وقالت يا حبيبي انت كل يوم عندك الف سؤال جديد
examples.english: The mother laughed and said, 'My darling, every day you have a thousand new questions.'
examples.transliteration: Daheket el omm w qalet ya habibi enta koll yom 'andak alf su'al jadeed.

examples.arabic: بعدين شفت ست كبيرة وسألتها نفس السؤال وهي فهمتني بسرعة
examples.english: Then I saw an old woman and asked her the same question, and she understood me quickly
examples.transliteration: Ba'dein shoft sett kbeereh w sa'altaha nafs el su'al w heeya fehmetni bi sur'a
